conviction_note: READ FIRST: the release was NOT ahead of this hunt. TDnet stamps the FY2026/8 決算短信 at 10:00 JST on 2026-10-15, six minutes before the baseline sealed (01:06 UTC = 10:06 JST), so every finding below is a reading of the published release, not a pre-release forecast. The sealed spot of 2101 matches kabutan's 15-minute-delayed pre-release quotes (2098-2104 at 09:52-09:54 JST; prior close 2156, open 2108), so the scored window should still hold the whole reaction. No price printed after 10:00 JST was looked at or used. The resolver and the panel should treat this name as release-preceded-seal and decide for themselves whether it is comparable with the day's other names. On the substance: FY26 recurring profit (経常) came in 19.5% above the IFIS consensus, and the first FY27 guide is 8-11% above consensus on every profit line. Against that, the dividend is held at 70 yen, the beat comes almost entirely from battery-station sales while the August grid-connection cap is now written into the release, and 信用倍率 sits at 99x with July buyers at 2,700-2,800 still under water. The findings sum to +3.0. The scaled number is +2.88 (p_up 68 x abs 8.0). The two agree because the per-finding sizes and p_up rest on the same document.
bar: FY2027/8 recurring profit (経常利益) guide of 13,500m against an IFIS consensus of 12,465m dated 2026-10-14. On the other lines: OP 15,600 vs 14,225, NP 9,379 vs 8,470, revenue 70,412 vs 64,025. FY2026 actual 経常 was 11,435 vs consensus 9,570 (+19.5%), and Q4 was 8,036 vs a Q4 consensus of 5,861. Source: https://kabuyoho.ifis.co.jp/index.php?action=tp1&sa=consNewsDetail&nid=1407_20261015_act_20261015_100013_1. Caveat: the FY26 consensus was 11,106 four weeks earlier and fell 13.8% in the week to 2026-09-30 (https://kabuyoho.ifis.co.jp/index.php?action=tp1&sa=report&bcode=1407), so the street's informed number may sit above the published 9,570/12,465. One bar source only.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register 1.32% (one seller) as of 2026-10-14, down 0.13pt, so shorts were covering slightly (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, via the baseline). 信用倍率 is 99.28x per kabutan and the baseline, so leveraged retail is crowded long with almost no margin short. There is no option skew. priced_lean_pct is +0.32. The stock fell from 2,802 on 2026-07-15 (day after Q3, +21.7%) to 2,156 by 2026-10-14. 20d run-up -5.36%, 5d -5.4%.

findings.finding: The first FY2027/8 guide sits above the IFIS consensus on every line: 経常 13,500m vs 12,465m (+8.3%), OP 15,600m vs 14,225m (+9.7%), NP 9,379m vs 8,470m (+10.7%, EPS 236.5 yen), revenue 70,412m vs 64,025m (+10%). That puts the stock at about 8.9x guided EPS at the 2,101 spot.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At the last two full-year prints (estimated cadence dates 2024-10-16 and 2025-10-15) the stock moved -11.5% and -5.0%. The FY26 initial guide (経常 +21.5%) still drew -5.0%. The more recent prints, with profit running ahead of plan, drew +2.7%, +9.3% and +21.7% (baseline history).
findings.why_not_priced: The guide was published at 10:00 JST, after the pre-release spot of 2101. Before the release the stock sat at about 9.1x a consensus EPS near 220 (IFIS PER* 9.8x at 2,156) and had fallen 23% since July. If a guide 8-10% above the street had already been priced, the stock would not have been trading at the lows of its post-Q3 range with consensus targets of 3,167.
findings.independence: The same numbers appear in the company's own 短信 (https://www.release.tdnet.info/inbs/140120261014550893.pdf) and on kabutan (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=1407&b=k202610150001). Both are the same release, so this is one fact.

findings.finding: FY2026/8 came in well above the bar: 経常 11,435m vs IFIS consensus 9,570m (+19.5%) and vs the unrevised company plan 9,676m (+18.2%); Q4 (Jun-Aug) 経常 8,036m vs Q4 consensus 5,861m; the Q4 operating margin rose to 30.7% from 26.2%; EPS 202.7 yen vs plan 166.5.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At Q3 (2026-07-15) cumulative 経常 progress reached 35.1% against 21.1% at the same point a year earlier, and the stock rose 21.7%. That beat is the reason this one is partly expected.
findings.why_not_priced: Only partly unpriced. The Q3 progress rate and the run of target-price raises into the print (Morgan Stanley MUFG 2,600->3,000 on 9/28, SMBC Nikko 2,410->2,900 on 10/1) told holders a beat was coming, and the FY26 consensus stood at 11,106m four weeks before the print. The published consensus had fallen to 9,570m, though, and the stock had drifted down, which is not what a fully priced 19% beat looks like. Sized small for that reason.
findings.independence: Kabutan's rating dailies (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=1407&b=n202609280872 and https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=1407&b=n202610011056) show two brokers raising targets into the print. That is a different source on the same expectation, and it says this was partly anticipated.

findings.finding: The FY2027 dividend is guided flat at 70 yen (35 interim + 35 final) while guided EPS rises 16.6%, so the payout ratio falls from 34.5% to 29.6%. No 増配, no buyback and no 株主優待 change came in the same TDnet batch.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At the 2025-10-15 print the company guided the dividend from 65 to 70 and the stock still fell 5.0%. There is no clean read on how this name reacts to dividends.
findings.why_not_priced: Kabutan carried the name on its 高配当利回り best-30 list on 10/14, so yield buyers sit in the register. A held dividend against a 17% EPS rise is the one shareholder-return item a retail holder could have expected and did not get. It is new as of 10:00.

findings.finding: The beat is concentrated: battery-station (蓄電所) segment OP was 8,419m (+462%) out of 12,992m consolidated, while non-FIT solar OP fell 52.4% and came in below the initial plan. The release now writes in the per-operator cap on grid-connection studies for grid batteries that took effect on 2026-08-01, says the battery pipeline will be screened for 連系可能性や事業性, and says no new ground-mounted megasolar will be developed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print isolated this. The stock fell from about 2,760 on 2026-08-28 to about 2,150 by October, including -9.7% on 2026-09-02 with no company news on kabutan. That is consistent with the market already pricing the battery-connection policy.
findings.why_not_priced: The cap itself is two and a half months old and largely priced, judging by the September de-rating. What is new is the company's own wording that it will cull the 1,600-application pipeline, together with a growth guide that leans on the same segment. Sized small, net of the rest: the FY27 guide above consensus already says management thinks the battery flow continues.
findings.independence: none (same 短信 as findings 2 and 3, different section)

findings.finding: 信用倍率 is 99.28x (kabutan, matching the baseline), so margin longs dwarf margin shorts. Many were added around the July spike at 2,700-2,800, about 25% above spot, which is supply that sells into any rally.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the +21.7% Q3 reaction the stock gave the whole move back within about six weeks (2,802 on 7/15 to 2,404 on 9/2 and 2,156 on 10/14): rallies were sold.
findings.source_date: 2026-10-15 (信用倍率 as displayed, weekly data)
findings.why_not_priced: The overhang is visible and partly in the baseline lean (margin_overhang component -0.998). What is filed here is only its effect on the size of a positive reaction, a capping of the upside rather than a directional call, so it is kept small.
findings.independence: Yahoo daily closes (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/1407.T?range=6mo&interval=1d) show the full give-back of the July gap.

New-year guide: 経常 13,500 vs IFIS 12,465 (+8.3%), OP +9.7%, NP +10.7%, so the first guide is above the street. Quarter vs own 進捗率: Q3 cumulative 35.1% vs 21.1% a year earlier already flagged the beat; Q4 経常 8,036 vs Q4 consensus 5,861.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Sept 2026 alliance with Mitsui & Co., Mizuho Bank, JA Mitsui Leasing and e-dash, plus the rooftop solar 10MW programme (2026-09-17) and Tohoku Hirose PPA (2026-10-01)
rejected_candidates.detail: Published weeks before the window with no quantified FY27 contribution beyond what the 短信 guide already carries; folded into finding 1 (the guide) rather than counted twice.

baseline_tension: The findings cut against the run-up: the stock fell 5.4% over five and twenty sessions into a release that beats consensus and guides above it. The lean (+0.32) is mildly positive and agrees in sign. Strongest negative looked for: a dividend held flat and battery-connection-cap language, both found and filed small. Strongest positive looked for: the guide versus consensus, found.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: rule 1 (a negative resting on public 月次/進捗率) does not touch these findings, whose negatives come from the release itself, and rule 2 (check the sign) was already satisfied because the strongest positive (the guide versus consensus) was looked for and is the largest finding
